reason: I'm home with the kids all week and always need somewhere to go that isn't the house. The free first visit and the gated Baby Nook for the little one make it worth a try, but I'd only pay for a couple of weekday visits.
objection: Will bigger kids be running wild around my baby? And $13 a visit adds up fast on one income when the library and park are free.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing on my free visit that the Baby Nook is really separate and the place isn't crowded, plus a cheaper way to go often, like a pack closer to $10 a visit.
